 Kathmandu Gurkhas Score 100 Runs for 9 Wickets in 18 Overs Against Janakpur Bolts
 Ratopati
 October 29, 2026
 Read in Nepali
 Kathmandu Gurkhas have scored 100 runs for 9 wickets in 18 overs in the Nepal Premier League (NPL) against Janakpur Bolts.
 Bhim Sarki scored a maximum of 33 runs for Kathmandu. He hit 4 fours in 29 balls. Rashid Khan scored 17, Smit Patel scored 13, and Sumit Maharjan scored 10 runs.
 Rahul Yadav took 4 wickets for Janakpur. Saif Hasan took 2, and Moin Ali and Lalit Rajbanshi took 1 wicket each. The game is ongoing.
